summary: Hawthorn Bancshares (HBI) entered into an Agreement and Plan of Reorganization to acquire FSC Bancshares (FBI) via a two-step merger, with FBI surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary then merging into HBI. FBI shareholders receive ~$14M cash (subject to equity adjustment) plus 413,101 HBI shares (exchange ratio per FBI share), totaling ~$28.3M value based on HBI's $34.57 close. The boards unanimously approved; no advisors named. The merger includes subsequent bank-level merger of Farmers State Bank into Hawthorn Bank. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder votes; risk-arb spread hinges on HBI stock movement and equity adjustment triggers.
